data.name: Leontine
data.gender_notes: Leontine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word leon, meaning lion. In ancient Greece, Leontine was a female given name that evoked strength, courage, and nobility. In the Christian tradition, it symbolizes the fierce protection and loyalty of the mother of God, or the Virgin Mary. The name Leontine carries the meaning “Lioness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leontine usually hope their child will grow to embody lioness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the protective and nurturing qualities of the divine feminine.
data.etymology: Leontine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lioness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leontine total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Λεοντίνη
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Λεοντίνη σημαίνει λιοντάρι ή θηρίο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Λεοντίνη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Λεων, που σημαίνει 'λιοντάρι' ή 'θηρίο'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Λεων δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά η σημασία του ονόματος συνδέεται με την έννοια της δύναμης και του θάρρους. Η Λεοντίνη είναι ένα όνομα που συμβολίζει την ανδρεία και τη γενναιότητα.

data.cultural_impact: Named after a powerful and brave Greek mythological figure, Leontine is a name that connotes strength, dignity, and determination. In many cultures, lions are seen as symbols of courage, power, and royalty. The name Leontine preserves this association with the noble and fearless qualities of the lion, making it a popular choice for those who seek to convey strong and independent personalities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the Virgin Mary is known as a gentle and loving protector, but her role as a powerful intercessor is also emphasized throughout history. Leontine is a name that honors this dual nature of Mary - the tender and compassionate mother, as well as the strong and unyielding defender. By bestowing this name upon a child, parents may seek to encourage and inspire their child to be strong in times of adversity, as well as compassionate towards others. The name Leontine is therefore a reminder of the fierce love and protection of the mother of God, and the strength and courage that we all can draw from her example.
